title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahme wegen Raubtat am S-Bahnhof Karlshorst

extraction.summaryEn: Follow-up to a robbery and assault on a 31-year-old man at Karlshorst S-Bahn station on 9 May 2026: five suspects aged 14 to 21 were searched, and one 21-year-old was arrested. The investigation continues.
